description:
Delete a gateway

Deletes it. Keys that had it as their default go back to none, so their requests run as without a gateway; a request still naming it is refused by the Model API (400 gateway_not_found). Both follow within about a minute: the router keeps a key's gateway and the account's gateway list for about 60 seconds, so until then a request may still run through the deleted gateway. 204 with no body.
name: delete_gateway
title: Delete a gateway
